name: accompaniment
description: acCompaniment soundboard. The app is the Rust binary in rust/app; this package holds the test tooling (node:test, Playwright).
author: Marcin Wardecki

scripts.build:tray: npm run build && node scripts/stage-sidecar.js && cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/tray/Cargo.toml
scripts.bundle:tray: npm run build && node scripts/stage-sidecar.js && cd rust/tray && cargo tauri build
scripts.bundle:tray:mac-universal: cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --manifest-path rust/app/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path rust/app/Cargo.toml && node scripts/stage-sidecar.js --universal && cd rust/tray && cargo tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --release --manifest-path rust/app/Cargo.toml && cargo test --release --manifest-path rust/tray/Cargo.toml
